name: buddy-script
description: Buddy Script - a small social feed (Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/api run db:deploy && npm --prefix apps/api run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web exec tsc -- --noEmit
